subject: Planned maintenance: eu-west rolling driver & kernel rollout (Nov 7-10)
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>

Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Planned maintenance: eu-west rolling driver & kernel rollout (Nov 7-10)

Hi Alicia —

Heads up from infra: we have a scheduled, low-risk maintenance window in eu-west to roll out a GPU driver + minimal kernel micro-updates. The work is purely driver-level and targets performance/regression fixes identified in the last benchmark sweep.

Planned windows (rolling across capacity groups so customer impact is minimized):
- Nov 7, 22:00–02:00 UTC — canary pool (small subset of hosts)
- Nov 8–10, nightly 02:00–06:00 UTC — staggered rolling restarts across AZs

What to expect:
- Each host will be drained and restarted; single-host downtime while the node reboots is expected to be ~3–6 minutes.
- We will maintain 2x redundancy for serving pools; production traffic should not see sustained errors but short-lived retries may occur for in-flight requests.
- Batching windows may see slight latency spikes for the first few minutes after a node re-enters the pool.
- Dedicated/reserved customers will be scheduled to avoid their configured peak if requested.

Attachments: eu-driver-rollout-plan-v3.pdf (plan), driver-changelog-202611.txt (changelog), maintenance-schedule-eu.csv (detailed per-pool times).

If you want us to include CloudGrid in the canary on Nov 7 (we recommend it for high-volume customers), please confirm by EOD Nov 4. If you prefer deferral or a custom window we can accommodate that with a short form (link below).

Status page: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/2026-11-eu-west-maintenance
Runbook (internal): https://docs.redwood.com/runbooks/eu-driver-rollout

Thanks —
Markus Klein

Thanks Markus — appreciate the heads up. A few quick questions from our infra team: 

1) Will there be any expected 5xx error surface during the restarts, or will failing requests be retried by the Redwood runtime automatically?
2) How will batch/scheduled jobs be affected (we run a nightly bulk-embedding job starting at 02:30 UTC)?
3) For the canary: can CloudGrid be included? We have a critical processing window on Nov 8 morning (UTC) and would like to verify behavior beforehand.

If you can confirm the plan and the canary timing, we can lock in the date. Also: is there a contact on-call during the canary window?

Best,
Alicia

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-11-03 09:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Planned maintenance: eu-west rolling driver & kernel rollout (Nov 7-10)

Markus — looping in Laura for customer success coordination. Quick internal note:

- Runtime behavior: we will auto-retry transient connection failures up to 2x at the transport layer; 5xx errors are not expected. In the canary we will enable an aggressive retry policy and extended logging for 60m after patch.
- Batch jobs: recommend CloudGrid postpone heavy batch runs that start within 30 minutes of their AZ window start. We will provide per-pool start times in maintenance-schedule-eu.csv and an ETA for when the pool is fully rebalanced.
- Canary candidates: CloudGrid and Acme Finance (we already have a support touchpoint with Rajesh). If both agree, we run canaries on Nov 7 22:00 UTC against a single small host group.

Action items for this thread (internal):
1) Add CloudGrid and Acme Finance to SUP-4589 and create canary tickets.
2) Prep an on-call rotation: infra-oncall, ops-oncall, and CS on-call for customer comms.
3) Update status page template with per-customer impact rows.

I'll draft the short customer-facing FAQ for CS to publish after we confirm canaries.

—Hannah
Senior Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Cortez <acortez@cloudgrid.io>, Rajesh Patel <rpatel@acme-finance.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-04 16:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Planned maintenance: eu-west rolling driver & kernel rollout (Nov 7-10)

Alicia — thanks for the quick reply and the ask to be included.

Confirmed plan for CloudGrid canary: Nov 7 22:00 UTC (canary pool, single small host group). We will: 
- Enable aggressive retry logic for your tenant for the first 60 minutes after the canary completes.
- Keep enhanced request logs available and will share a short packet of metrics (p90 latency, 5xx counts, dropped requests) 2 hours post-canary.
- Have infra-oncall (pager), ops-oncall, and Laura CS on standby for immediate escalation.

For your nightly bulk-embedding job: we strongly recommend shifting the start to after 03:30 UTC on the nights when your pools are in the rotation. If that isn't possible, we can coordinate a per-customer hold that prevents your dedicated hosts from being restarted during your job window — that will require acceptance of a slightly later host patch for those machines (we can schedule that between Nov 10–12).

If you want to defer entirely, submit a maintenance-deferral request here: https://support.redwood.com/tickets/new?ref=maintenance-deferral — include your preferred window and we will confirm.

Attachments included: maintenance-schedule-eu.csv (your per-pool times).

I'll post a short FAQ on the status page before the canary and will ping you when the canary begins.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
